title: car rug
text: car rug. I have to admit, I was expecting this to be more a carpet top (the print side)... hook and loop? Something... but it is not.  It's like a felt?  But not as heavy - cheap looking and feeling.  It was crammed into a bag and very severely taped in about a 8"x*8" square- so I have laid it out and hoping it will flatten... eventually.  The back has little rubber dots.. supposedly to help it not slide around - and it kind of works.  And that's on carpet!  We do have a smooth, quality burber carpet - but sheesh.  Anyway... I hope this will last one summer and we will move one from it.  Overall, disappointed in the value and quality.
